title: Candidate
description: Cosmos DB 'candidates' container document. Partition key: /candidate_id.

candidate_id.description: Stable UUID, generated at ingest; the partition key.

source_blob_path.description: Path in the raw-resumes Blob container.

jd_id.description: FK to jd-corpus / jd_id this candidate was parsed against.

ranking_tier.description: Output of ResumeMEtrics.py classify_candidate(); populated after scoring, not at parse time.

assigned_interviewer_usernames.description: Record-level access scope for the 'interviewer' role (auth.py's interviews.assign permission, set via PUT /candidates/{id}/assign-interviewer) -- a username in this list may read this candidate's record/interview transcripts; one who is NOT in it, and holds no broader role, is denied (see api_blueprint.py's _interviewer_may_access()). Absent/empty on legacy candidates -- treated as 'no interviewer assigned yet', not a schema violation.
